o7.why: F3a shows narrow sub-um peaks at low concentration and a visibly broader peak reaching several um at 20 mg/ml; the reader missed the broadening.

o3.why: The F1b insets show irregular clustered particles at pH 4 and discrete spheres at pH 6 and 9; the reader reversed the trend.

x3b.why: In F2c the 5-40 s traces are identical and the 60 s trace is clearly broadened toward lower wavenumber; the reader missed it.

o6.why: In F2c the 60 s Amide I band is flattened and broadened toward ~1630 cm-1, unlike the 5-40 s traces; the reader erred.

x5.why: F6d is one confocal snapshot of uniformly dyed particles and does not show the surface-to-matrix diffusion process, which only the text states.
